intro: A customer service resume that turns busy days into evidence: volumes handled, satisfaction scores and the improvements that made customers' lives easier.

basics.label: Customer Service Representative

Wrote 40 help-centre answers that reduced repeat contacts about refunds by 25%.
Train new team members in their first two weeks; 30 trained so far.
